formal_statement: ∀ k : ℕ, 128 ≤ k → ∃ (r d : ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ) (g : Fin (11 * k) × Fin (11 * k) → MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ), k ≤ 3 * r ∧ k ^ 2 ≤ 100 * d + 100 ∧ G.IsHomogeneous r ∧ (∀ x : Fin d → ℂ, (∀ i, MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.pderiv i G) = 0) → x = 0) ∧ (∀ i, (g i).totalDegree ≤ 1) ∧ MvPolynomial.bind₁ g (PEqualNP.Gct.permPoly ℂ (11 * k)) = G
plain_statement: Chain link 2, NOT routine (its Props 3.1, 6.1, 7.2, 7.3): for k at least 128 an affine substitution turns the permanent of size 11k into a smooth form of degree at least k/3 in at least k^2/100 - 1 variables. Method: matching gadgets, then the singular locus bounded by reduction mod 2, plane spectral curves, adjugate ideals and Severi dimension bounds. Source: the unrefereed manuscript of 24 September 2026 on a cubic lower bound for border dc of the permanent (cited by arXiv:2610.40484); read once by a leg, not verified here.
title: The permanent of size 11k restricts to a smooth form of degree at least k/3 in about k^2/100 variables
